snippet.title: DBP74: Phantom Processing - Showcase
snippet.description:
DBP74: Phantom Processing is a eight-map Doom II episode for limit-removing source ports created by the fine folks at Doomer Boards, lead by 40oz. The theme is green and purple techbases. It is the 74th installment in the ongoing Doomer Boards Project series and released on July 2nd, 2025.

You can get the project at:
https://doomer.boards.net/thread/4043/phantom-processing
https://www.moddb.com/mods/dbp74-phantom-processing

MAPLIST:
00:00 - MAP01: "Airwalk" by 40oz
00:47 - MAP02: "Insertion Point" by digbone
01:32 - MAP03: "Night Raid" by TheHockster
02:14 - MAP04: "Dark Metallurgy" by gije
02:59 - MAP05: "Refining Station 7" by Tangra
03:41 - MAP06: "Trust the Process(ing)" by thelokk
04:34 - MAP07: "3 2 1 Meltdown!" by joe-ilya
05:43 - MAP08: "Phantom Processing" by 40oz

06:12 - Doomer Boards will return...

Please check out our other projects: https://doomer.boards.net/page/dbp
